scope: Bounded discovery, US total model sales, includes fleet. No bulk collection, agents, paid data or causal fitting.
vintage: 2019/20 from 2020 release, 2021 from 2021 release, 2022 from 2023 release, 2023/24 from 2024 release. Original 2023 Charger75920 revised comparative75898; not silently mixed.

findings.claim: Cherokee decline predates production stop; healthy pre-exit retail demand not established.
findings.evidence: Sales 191397 in2019 to40322 in2022. Belvidere stopped February28 2023. Semiconductor constraints confound realized sales.

findings.claim: Belvidere rationale included funding/absorbing EV transition costs and footprint optimization.
findings.evidence: Tavares remarks reported contemporaneously by AP February28 2023.
findings.status: Management rationale, not proof Cherokee unprofitable.

findings.claim: Charger/Challenger held up better in2020–22, both fell2023.
findings.status: Does not establish healthy margins, incentives or retail mix.

findings.claim: Gas Charger was in plan by March2024; do not describe entire strategy as permanent EV-only replacement.
findings.evidence: March5 2024 announcement scheduled ICE SIXPACK Q12025. Oct30 2025 call still described production as forthcoming.
findings.status: Documented slippage; model/trims and deliveries distinct.

findings.claim: Some Dodge inventory was deliberately built as a bridge.
findings.evidence: User-provided July25 2024 call p8; October31 2024 call p13 corroborates same management account.
findings.status: Management assertion; no model inventory quantity or adequacy established.

findings.claim: Renegade unprofitability explicitly stated; cannot transfer statement to Cherokee.

findings.evidence: Public loyalty search did not yield model owner transition matrix. Mustang fell9.5%2024.
findings.status: Mustang decline challenges simple absorption story, does not rule out gross conquest.

findings.claim: 2025–26 strategy restores ICE choice and introduces conventional hybrid Cherokee; planned Ram BEV canceled.
findings.status: Product action is not proof of sustainable retail recovery.

powertrain_definitions.ICE: Combustion engine, gasoline or diesel; V8 to turbo I6 is still ICE.
powertrain_definitions.MHEV: Small electric assist; not equivalent to full hybrid.
powertrain_definitions.HEV: Full hybrid engine plus motor; no external charging. New Cherokee.
powertrain_definitions.PHEV: Engine plus rechargeable battery allowing electric driving; historical Wrangler/GrandCherokee4xe and PacificaHybrid.
powertrain_definitions.BEV: Battery and motors only; needs charging. ChargerDaytona.
powertrain_definitions.EREV: Electric wheel drive with combustion generator extending range; plug-in architecture, not BEV.

limitations: No matched model incentive/transaction-price history; no model contribution margins.
No public owner-level migration dataset obtained; online anecdotes not quantified.
Chip shortages and allocation can depress sales before discontinuation.
Last Call effects and final-year discounts remain unmeasured.
Powertrain outcomes require net STLA retail accounting, avoiding internal cannibalization and dealer refill.
Contemporary2026 PHEV withdrawal report surfaced; avoid treating historic4xe lineup as unchanged current availability.
next_step: Highest information gain: owner return-to-market destination table for Cherokee, Charger, Challenger (brand/model, new/used, retail, time period, denominators) if available through existing subscriptions; paired pre-exit model incentives/inventory to distinguish healthy demand from clearance. No purchase authorized.
